en.headline: John Lee urges youth to stay curious at third development summit
en.dek: More than 3,300 people registered for the flagship forum at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, where the Chief Executive said the first five-year plan would expand opportunities.
body: Chief Executive John Lee has called on young people to remain curious and courageous at the third Hong Kong Youth Development Summit, held today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Organised by the Home and Youth Affairs Bureau, the forum carried the theme of pioneering new fields for youth and attracted more than 3,300 registered participants, including officials, experts and young leaders from the mainland and about 35 countries.

In a video address, Mr Lee said the government’s first five-year plan for economic and social development provided a clear blueprint that would enhance opportunities for youth and help nurture a new generation with international vision and aspiration. He described the summit as a springboard for cultural exchange and lasting connections.

He noted that the Youth Development Blueprint had already introduced more than 290 measures, including exchanges, internships and learning experiences aimed at broadening horizons, and that the government was working with schools, businesses and community partners to create an environment in which young people could realise their potential.

Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki also addressed the opening, saying the five-year plan and the latest Policy Address both placed youth development in a priority position, including plans for an international youth talent exchange base.

zh.headline: 青年發展高峰論壇開幕 李家超籲青年保持好奇心勇於開拓
zh.dek: 第三屆論壇在灣仔會展舉行，逾3300人登記參加，行政長官以視像致辭指首個五年規劃將提升青年機遇。
body: 第三屆「香港青年發展高峰論壇」今日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，行政長官李家超以視像形式致辭，呼籲青年保持好奇心、勇於開拓並追求卓越。
論壇由民政及青年事務局主辦，主題為「開拓青年新領域 逐夢前行創未來」，吸引超過3300人登記參加，當中包括來自內地及約35個國家的官員、青年專家與領袖。
李家超表示，香港首個五年規劃為經濟及社會發展提供清晰藍圖，可進一步提升青年發展機遇，培育具國際視野、有抱負的新一代。他形容論壇是文化交流與建立長遠聯繫的跳板。
他指出，《青年發展藍圖》至今已推出超過290項措施，透過交流、實習及學習體驗擴闊青年視野，政府亦與學校、商界及社區夥伴合作，營造有利環境讓青年發揮潛能。
政務司司長陳國基亦出席致辭，表示五年規劃與最新施政報告均將青年發展放於優先位置，包括籌劃國際青年人才交流基地等。
